name: subagent-models
description: Native Claude Code subagents on non-Claude models (OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible APIs), with fallback chains. Sign in to the hosted gateway and set up providers and agents from the /subagent-models pane.

gatewayUrl.title: Gateway URL
gatewayUrl.description: Leave empty for the hosted gateway (https://llm-gateway.execution.associates). Set it only to use a gateway you run yourself. SUBAGENT_MODELS_URL overrides it.

apiKey.title: Gateway key
apiKey.description: Not needed for the hosted gateway: sign in with /subagent-models instead. A key for a gateway you run yourself, sent as a Bearer token. SUBAGENT_MODELS_API_KEY overrides it.
